end.summary:
Practised levels of organisation: cell, tissue, organ, organ system, organism.
Gave human and plant examples at the levels; 2 unaided examples were correct.
Ordered the levels correctly in 2 of 3 attempts.
Discussed that the heart is one organ, while the circulatory system includes the heart, blood vessels and blood; this was corrected later in the lesson.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised ordering the levels and linking cells to tissues, organs, organ systems and organisms. Yash explained that muscle cells form muscle tissue and that the heart is an organ; the mix-up between the heart and the circulatory system was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Yash to write the five levels in order and add one human and one plant example for each.
